product.name: Lymio Men's Lightweight Outwear Sportswear Bomber Jacket
product.description: A men's lightweight bomber jacket designed for casual and sportswear use. It features a regular fit, long sleeves, solid pattern and standard length construction. The jacket is positioned for winter and mild weather use.

review_summary.summary: The jacket has substantial review data but mixed customer experiences. Some customers praise its comfort, appearance, fabric and value for money, while others report poor stitching, defective products, sizing problems and damaged items.
positive: Some customers describe the jacket as stylish
Some customers consider it good value for money
Some customers find it suitable for early winter or cool weather
negative: Poor stitching reported by multiple customers
Some customers reported seams tearing under the arms
Some customers consider the jacket not worth ₹800
The product is marked as frequently returned
review_summary.main_concern: Quality-control consistency is the biggest concern. The review set contains both positive quality reports and serious complaints about stitching and defective units.

appearance.note: Customers describe the jacket as stylish, while the product itself has a simple solid bomber design.

fit.note: The official specification says regular fit, but customers report both good fitting and sizing problems.

comfort.note: Some customers specifically describe the jacket as comfortable and lightweight.

fabric_quality.note: Some customers praise the fabric, while other reviews criticize overall quality.

stitching_quality.note: Multiple reviews raise stitching concerns, including a report of seams tearing under the armpits shortly after use.

value_for_money.note: Several customers consider the jacket good value at its price, but some customers explicitly say it is not worth ₹800.

warmth.note: The product is categorized for winter and mild weather, while customer feedback describes it as suitable for early winter or slightly cool weather.

durability.note: Durability concerns are raised by reports of poor stitching and seams tearing.

weather_suitability.note: The official listing identifies mild weather suitability and winter season positioning. Customer feedback supports early-winter/cool-weather use.

waterproofing.note: The supplied source does not establish waterproof or water-resistant performance.

pros: Some customers report good value for money
cons: Heavy winter insulation is not established

best_for: Customers wanting a simple bomber jacket
Customers looking for a jacket under ₹1000
not_ideal_for: Customers who want highly consistent sizing
Customers unwilling to tolerate quality-control risk
buying_advice.size_advice: The listed fit is regular and sizes S, M, L, XL and 2XL are available. However, customer reviews contain sizing complaints, so the shopper should check the size chart carefully rather than assuming the jacket runs true to size.
buying_advice.weather_advice: This is better positioned as a lightweight jacket for mild weather, early winter and slightly cool conditions. Do not market it as a heavy winter jacket.
buying_advice.quality_advice: The product has a meaningful review volume, but the evidence is mixed. Positive reviews mention comfort, fabric and value, while negative reviews report poor stitching, damaged products and tearing. Quality consistency should be treated as the main purchase risk.
buying_advice.sales_advice: Lead with the ₹799 price, lightweight bomber styling, Black/Grey options, regular fit and S-2XL size range. Do not describe it as premium or highly durable.
buying_advice.risk_advice: Because Amazon flags the product as frequently returned and reviews contain repeated quality and sizing complaints, Shopi AI should surface this risk when a customer explicitly asks whether the jacket is reliable.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_product: Describe it as a lightweight polyester bomber jacket with a regular fit, solid pattern, long sleeves, band collar and standard length. Mention Black and Grey variants and S-2XL sizes.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_if_good: Give a balanced answer. It is affordable and some customers like its comfort, style and value, but the 3.3/5 rating and repeated complaints about stitching, defects and sizing mean it should not be presented as a reliably high-quality jacket.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_fit: Explain that the listed fit is regular and sizes range from S to 2XL. Warn that customer reviews contain sizing complaints and recommend checking the size chart.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_winter: Describe it as suitable for mild weather, early winter and slightly cool conditions. Do not call it a heavy winter jacket.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_quality: Explain that the evidence is mixed. Some customers praise the fabric and comfort, while multiple customers report poor stitching, defects and tearing.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_colors: The supplied variants are Black and Grey.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_hood: Do not claim that it has a hood. The supplied specification lists a Band collar and does not establish a hood.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_waterproofing: Do not call it waterproof or water-resistant because the supplied product data does not establish either.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_pockets: Do not make a pocket-count claim because the supplied product specification does not establish the number or type of pockets.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_care: The listed care instruction is Machine Wash.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_alternatives: Prioritize lightweight men's bomber or casual jackets with similar pricing, but favor alternatives with stronger ratings and fewer quality-control complaints when the customer prioritizes durability.
shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_for_best_product: Do not rank this jacket as the best purely because of its ₹799 price. Consider its 3.3 rating, frequent-return flag, sizing complaints and stitching complaints alongside its positive comfort and value feedback.

shopi_ai_rules.when_customer_asks_about_value: At ₹799, the jacket can be considered budget-friendly, and some customers report good value. However, the price does not eliminate the quality and sizing risks reported in reviews.
